name: Hell Wind
description:
Deals wind damage with a potency of 300 to all enemies in a straight line.
Potency increases to 390 when used against targets weak to wind.
Drain Touch Potency: 400
Potency increases to 520 when used against targets weak to wind.
Potency scales with item level.
Consumes 10% of maximum HP when executed.
Additional Effect: 10% chance to Petrify target when under the effect of Drain Touch
Petrify Effect: Incapacitated upon taking damage
Duration: 10s
Additional Effect: Afflicts yourself with Doom
Duration: 10s
Effect is dispelled when HP is restored to full.
Shares a recast timer with Deep Freeze.
